causes.name: Harbor Relief Fund
causes.blurb: Fictional demo organisation: medical and emergency relief for civilians in a sanctioned region.
causes.story: Harbor Relief Fund is a fictional humanitarian non-profit providing medical supplies, emergency response and relief to civilians - not weapons. For someone inside Norvelia, a made-up country used in this demo, donating to aid in a sanctioned region can carry heavy legal consequences even though the help is purely humanitarian. Cloak lets people support civilians without leaving a public trail that marks them as a supporter.

causes.name: Open Docket
causes.blurb: Fictional demo organisation: documents political arrests and gives legal aid to detainees.
causes.story: Open Docket is a fictional human-rights project that tracks political arrests and provides legal aid to detainees. In the made-up country of Norvelia it has been added to the registry of 'extremist' organisations, so openly supporting it inside the country is now dangerous. The people most likely to give - those who fear the same knock on the door - are exactly the people most exposed by giving. Cloak removes the public link so support is no longer self-incriminating.

causes.name: Lantern Post
causes.blurb: Fictional demo organisation: independent journalism, declared 'undesirable' inside Norvelia.
causes.story: Lantern Post is a fictional independent newsroom reporting on government decisions and on repression that state media will not cover. In the made-up country of Norvelia it has been labelled a 'foreign agent' and an 'undesirable organisation', which makes funding it a legal risk for people inside the country. A public on-chain donation is permanent proof that you supported them. Cloak breaks that proof while still letting Lantern Post show the funds are clean.
